propositions: BindingStore's 799-line monolithic module conflates byte persistence, lifecycle policy, recovery, rotation, and mutation semantics with no cohesive ownership
Production code mutates inner entries returned by shallow all_bindings() query, creating unsafety around crash, index-lag, identity, serialization, and selective-publication behavior
New journal-free retirement completion rule requires durable tombstone as authoritative intent; live forward/reverse pairs must be removed only when tombstone, forward, and reverse identities agree
Automatic liveness observations and same-key confirm cannot revoke a durable tombstone; only explicit unretire removes it
Recovery must run after preflight and exclusive lock validation but before remote issue fetch, binding walk, or lifecycle mutation to prevent interleaving of new liveness evidence with completion

Refactoring must preserve byte format, unknown fields, indent=2, sorted keys, five-file selective publication, pending/confirmed/reversed retired lifecycle, and rotation/comment/numeric-ID identity without journal, eager rewrite, or deep-copy of all_bindings()
